mouthShader.note: GLTFLoader lowercases custom attribute names; values use source-space scalar distances and MUST NOT be swizzled or transformed. Pass to fragment shader as varyings before skinning. uMouthOpen must match Boca - abrir weight.
mouthShader.fragmentInsertion: After #include <map_fragment> for diffuse shading and before #include <opaque_fragment> to suppress reflected light inside the mouth.

anatomicalCorrection.reference: Genuine dark seam directly under moustache; above light lower lip

runtime: Audio-driven mouth aligned with the natural lip seam, restrained chin motion, and body/finger gestures. Irregular blinks, curved eyelid closure and coordinated small gaze shifts through dedicated morphs. Eye and eyelid surfaces follow Cabeca. Reduced motion restores neutral eyes.

eyeAnimation.lidClosure: Upper lid provides most closure; lower lid rises toward the shared overlapping seam in front of the cornea.
eyeAnimation.arcWeight: 4 * blink * (1 - blink), independently for D and E

handAnimation.phraseMotion: Opening, gathering and release; delayed articulation from base to distal joints; alternating lead hands.
handAnimation.thumbOpposition: Opposition at the thumb base, directed toward the palm according to the exported anatomy.
handAnimation.waveMotion: Progressive opening and two coordinated soft relaxations while the palm is raised.
handAnimation.smoothing: Critically damped angular channels; gradual relaxation during pauses and interruption.
handAnimation.leftSkinBridge: Ring and little fingers use matched flexion and timing to preserve their shared skin.
handAnimation.validation: Deformed GLB fingertip vertices measured in palm coordinates, with local audio and Blender pose renders.

mouthAudio.mode: Audio energy and spectral shape, not phoneme recognition
mouthAudio.adaptation: Bounded per-playback sensitivity learned only during voice; no added envelope filtering

bodyAnimation.footContact: Two-bone inverse kinematics retains neutral ankle positions and sole orientations during speech.
bodyAnimation.weights: Redistributes only the lower-body Base influence; existing hand, facial and arm weights remain unchanged. Coat panels blend the pelvis and thighs.
bodyAnimation.phraseMotion: Gentle trunk lean and rotation; counterbalanced shoulders and pelvis; support alternates every two phrases with slow damped transitions.
bodyAnimation.pauseBehavior: Returns gradually to the idle posture; reduced motion restores original rotations, scales and positions.
bodyAnimation.validation: Actual GLB sole and knee vertices, frame-rate comparison, interruptions, repeated timestamps and model-space foot anchors.

idleAnimation.breathing: Variable breath durations with gradual inhalation and exhalation; relaxed shoulders.
idleAnimation.posture: Independent slow head, neck and pelvic adjustments with quiet holds and planted feet.
idleAnimation.hands: Occasional coordinated relaxation with different timings for each hand; no repeated finger tapping.
idleAnimation.transitions: Idle movement blends smoothly with speech and yields to explicit gestures.
idleAnimation.clock: Local visible-time clock; delayed frames do not replay missed movements; reduced motion restores rest transforms.
idleAnimation.face: Mouth remains audio-driven and closed in silence; independent gaze and eyelid animation preserved.
idleAnimation.events: Forearms brought forward into a resting posture for several seconds, a decided transfer of weight over one leg with softened knees and counterbalance, and an occasional deeper breath raising both shoulders; each on its own slow clock, feet planted throughout.

prosodyAnimation.beats: Audio onsets (a syllable clearly louder than the recent voice, or a new phrase) trigger short head nods or tilts and a wrist stroke of the leading hand, with per-beat variation and a 260 ms refractory interval; a constant level does not keep nodding.
prosodyAnimation.phraseAttitudes: Each phrase settles the head into a different yaw, pitch and roll, shifts part way midway through longer phrases, and begins with a small catch breath.
prosodyAnimation.handPlacements: Five alternating conversational placements for arm depth, forearm lift and hand angle, blended with damped channels.
prosodyAnimation.nod: Two decreasing dips with a slight tilt and no swing above rest.
prosodyAnimation.wave: The shoulder rises with the raised arm and the head tilts slightly toward the greeting; torso and head return exactly.
prosodyAnimation.gaze: The head follows a fraction of each glance with a short delay; the eyes counter-rotate against measured head yaw and pitch to keep contact with the visitor, within a comfortable morph range.
prosodyAnimation.blinks: A planned blink may be advanced to coincide with a gaze shift without shortening the minimum interval between blinks.
prosodyAnimation.clock: Beats, attitudes and breaths are functions of elapsed time; reduced motion clears them and restores rest transforms.
prosodyAnimation.validation: Timeline sampled from the coupled controllers with the local poetry audio; Blender world positions checked against it within 0.05 mm; eye morphs within 1e-5.

attentionAnimation.runtime: web/lib/avatar/rig.ts and web/lib/avatar/eyes.ts; components/AvatarStage.tsx attend(); components/ConversationApp.tsx phases
attentionAnimation.listening: While the visitor records, the head tilts and leans slightly toward them, holds stiller with steadier eye contact, and a pause after a stretch of their voice earns one small acknowledging nod (visitor RMS x5, voiced above 0.06, one nod per pause, 2.5 s apart).
attentionAnimation.thinking: While a reply or its voice is being prepared, the gaze averts up and aside and the head follows a fraction; contact resumes when the reply begins.
attentionAnimation.idle: Rest and speech use the idle attention; the visitor level is ignored outside listening.
attentionAnimation.transitions: Critically damped channels; reduced motion restores rest transforms and clears attention state.

capturedMotion.provenance: Mixamo, auto-rigged onto this same scan: its bind pose sits within 1 cm of ours, so the transfer is almost exact.
capturedMotion.retarget: World-space rotation delta measured from each rig's own rest pose, never a copy of local rotations - the two skeletons share proportions but not bone bases, which differ by 98 degrees at the upper arm and 180 at the thigh.
capturedMotion.fidelity: Every bone direction transfers to within 1e-4 degrees of constant; the only channel that varies is Coluna->Peito, by 1.2 degrees, because the source has a spine link we do not and Peito absorbs it.
capturedMotion.coverage: 29 bones. The source rig carries only thumb and index, so the middle, ring and little fingers stay on the procedural layer.
capturedMotion.greeting: cumprimento, 4.37 s. It does NOT stand in for the wave - a handshake is not a wave, and substituting one only stopped the wave being a wave. gesture("wave") is the procedural wave; the clip is played deliberately with playClip("cumprimento", now).
capturedMotion.walk: caminhada lends the body above the hips, the hips excluded (BELOW_THE_HIPS is an exact set; the old regex /Pe./ also matched Peito and Pescoco). It plays in step with the walker legs through WalkingFrame.stridePhase and the clip footfalls, its weight follows the walk weight, the procedural arm swing and gait twist yield to it, and steadyHead removes 70 percent of the head turn the clip itself adds.
capturedMotion.playback: In-place clips advance by ground covered rather than by the clock, so cadence follows speed instead of becoming slow motion.
capturedMotion.degradation: A clip that fails to load leaves the poet with the procedural gesture it replaces.
capturedMotion.asset: goncalves-dias.glb is untouched by this revision - same bytes, same 48 bones, same 11 morphs - so its cache key stays at attentive-presence-1 rather than making every visitor fetch 13 MB again. This revision covers runtime and clips.

bendBudget.why: A photogrammetry scan blends skin between bones that share a vertex, and past some angle the blend collapses inward. Pescoco and Cabeca share 9286 vertices - the jaw and the base of the face - and the sources bend that joint 52 degrees, at which the worst of them caves in by 14 mm. The procedural rig had never asked it for more than 0.4 degrees, so nothing had shown it.
bendBudget.measured: web/work/mocap-skin-budget.mjs, read off the GLB weights
bendBudget.allowance: 1.2 mm for the face and the chain that carries it, 4 mm for the wrist; shoulder, elbow, hip and knee left free - Coxa shares no vertices at all, and the procedural walk has bent the knee to 40 degrees all along.
bendBudget.applied: At generation each over-budget joint has its whole amplitude scaled to 95% of the budget (slerp from rest by limit/largest), so timing and shape survive and no joint ever parks on a limit. Frame-by-frame clamping had held a wrist at the limit 45% of the time in the talking clips and the spine 72% in the walk. The runtime holdBudget remains a last resort and does not engage with the recorded voice.
bendBudget.source: lib/avatar/bend-budget.json, read by the generator and enforced by the rig after every layer (holdBudget)
bendBudget.shoulder: Braco held to 44 degrees: the shipped procedural wave reaches 43.2, so no clip takes the skin past what the avatar already does. The talking clip asked 72.2 on the left shoulder, the walk 54.6.

capturedMotion.headingRemoval: The path heading of the circling source is taken out over a full stride. Read over six frames the hips' sideways sway dominated it, the heading appeared to swing at 176 deg/s, and removing that drove a curve into every bone: the pelvis of the built clip turned 41 degrees and the head 47. Corrected, the turn rate is 19.4 deg/s median and the torso leans sideways 0.84 degrees on average.
capturedMotion.clipsRevision: mocap-4 (budget applied by scaling each joint's whole motion, never clamping; talking hips centred across the floor)

captureAsReference.method: Captured and procedural motion measured with the same metrics; 9 discrepancies, each checked by 3 independent skeptics (re-measure, design intent, on-screen perception); 6 survived, 3 refuted.
captureAsReference.wave: Body participates: face 4.7 -> 15.4 px against the pelvis at the chat camera, free wrist 0 -> 24.9 px; held arm drift 0.006 -> 0.77 degrees.
captureAsReference.fallbackWalk: Elbow and wrist follow the shoulder on the continuous gait clock (117 ms lag; elbow-only 11.6 cm per stride, capture 11.0); shoulder line 0.95 -> 9.3 degrees per stride.
captureAsReference.loading: Clips load independently (Promise.allSettled); each failure is reported.
captureAsReference.knownLimits: Turning on the spot shows a full walking torso; Walk In Circle keeps the head near its budget. A straight Walking clip and a Waving clip would address both.

capturedMotion.speech: fala-1 and fala-2, from two Mixamo Talking clips, closed loops. Engaged while the poet speaks, above the hips, alternating per stretch of speech; weight follows speech presence (voice within the last 0.6 s), not syllable energy; played on the absolute clock. Hip travel (a 12 cm weight transfer) goes to the pelvis and the foot solver keeps the shoes planted. Face travel with the recorded voice at the chat camera: 15 x 2 px before, 82 x 25 px after; face stays within 3 degrees median of the listener.
